name: helium_balloon_buoyancy
title: Helium balloon buoyancy and acceleration (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for a spherical helium balloon of diameter 10 m. The air density is 1.16 kg/m³, the helium density is one seventh of that, and the mass is written as 70*2 kg. The model computes the buoyancy force, the total mass and the upward acceleration.
